''1ˢᵗ'' - Bisyeet |difficulty = Easy |length_measurement = 01:14.99 |wave_structure = Normal |rewards = {{RewardsList|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Fungi Island''' is an island [[Maps|map]] that replaced [[Fungi Forest]]. This map has been remade once since its addition to the game. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |'''Fungi Island''' is an island that has multiple luminous mushrooms of various sizes and colors growing on it. Multiple black rocks and cliffs can also be found on the island. There is also a small pond on it, with a bridge above it that enemies use as a path. The island is surrounded by water. The brown path begins and ends at two caves. It crosses over a wooden bridge to get over a small pond. There were two, very similar versions of this, with the only difference being that the current version has had some fungi removed from its cliffs. |Version 1 |'''Fungi Island''' has two islands that have luminous mushrooms growing on both of them. One of the island has purple grass, while the other has blue grass. Various flowers and fungi plants are dotted around both the islands. Both islands are surrounded by water, with a small river intersecting them. In the river, swans, fishes and floating lights can be seen. The black path begins and ends at two caves, one on each island. It crosses over a wooden flower bridge to get over the river, in which enemies walk at a minor incline. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Tabber |Current |{{Map:Fungi Island}} |Version 3 |{{Map:Fungi IslandV3}} |Version 2 |{{Map:Fungi Island}} }} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *This is a good map for cliff towers, as in the middle of the map are multiple cliff spots close to each other. *Ground towers should be placed around the start or middle of the path, as it allows them to cover most of the path. **As this map is quite long, you generally should not place your towers in the back, as it makes the game longer and allows enemies like the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] summon a large horde of [[Skeleton]]s, which can overwhelm players without enough DPS or any splash damage towers. *There are multiple corners and bends on this map's path, making towers with short range, like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Warden]] or [[Gladiator]] useful here. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} FungiIsland.png|First version (29 October 2020 – 31 October 2022) {{GalleryHeader|View}} FungiIslandV.png|First version (29 October 2020 – 31 October 2022) Remake Fungi Island View.png|Second version (31 October 2022 – 10 February 2024) FungiIslandViewV3.png|Third version (10 February 2024 – 6 August 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Top Down}} FungiIslandTopDownV3.png|Third version (10 February 2024 – 6 August 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} March 2023 Rebalancing Promotional Video|Current version on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} FungiIslandDI1.png|Current version on a development image. FungiIslandDI2.png|Current version on a development image. FungiIslandDI3.png|Current version on a development image. FungiIslandDI4.png|Current version on a development image. }} ==Trivia== *This map replaced [[Fungi Forest]] in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. *Several Robloxians could have been seen around the first version of the map (namely [https://www.roblox.com/users/53017915/profile SweetHiddenLove] and [https://www.roblox.com/users/178596165/profile Bisyeet]). *This map was formerly included in the map rotation for [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. **It got removed as it made [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode too easy. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Fungi Island''' added, replacing [[Fungi Forest]]. *'''31 October 2022''' - [[v1.4.2]] **'''Fungi Island''' remade. **Made playable in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. **[[Enemies Beta]] modifier added. **{{Bug}} Towers can be placed on the gap near the bridge, making them float. *'''4 February 2023''' - [[v1.6.1]] **No longer playable in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *'''10 February 2024''' - [[v1.13.0]] **{{Bug}} Multiple fungi are now removed from cliffs. *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Normal}} to {{Color|Easy}}. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **[[Enemies Beta]] removed. {{MapNavBox}}
